basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old horticulturist based in the Pacific Northwest, passionate about sustainable agriculture and indoor cannabis cultivation. Outside of growing, I enjoy heavy metal music, investing in emerging tech stocks, and diving into epic D&D campaigns. I'm usually online during the late evening hours after tending to my plants. Currently single, I work as a consultant for a tech startup that specializes in agricultural innovation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Botany, I've spent over a decade refining my skills in cannabis cultivation, merging traditional horticultural techniques with cutting-edge technology. I've also developed a keen interest in stock market trends, particularly in emerging tech sectors, which I follow closely.
